title: Navruz Holiday Celebrations
content: A large event titled "Welcome, Navruz!" was held at our school in celebration of the Navruz holiday. Students performed national songs and dances, and national dishes were showcased. The holiday was held in a traditional, uplifting spirit.
fullContent:
A large event titled "Welcome, Navruz!" was held at our school in celebration of the Navruz holiday.

Students sang national songs, performed dances, and prepared samples of national dishes. A special concert program was organized for the guests.

"Navruz is a holiday of renewal and unity. On this day, we once again feel love and respect for one another."

— Toshmatov E.G., School Director

At the end of the event, all participants were presented with commemorative gifts.

title: Spring Break Days
content: Attention students and parents: the 2024 spring break begins on March 21 and lasts for 7 calendar days.
fullContent:
Attention students and parents: the 2026 spring break schedule has been announced.

Spring break starts on March 21 and lasts for 7 calendar days. Various sports and cultural events have been organized for students during the break.

Classes will resume as usual on March 28.

title: New ICT Room Opened
content: A new information technology room equipped with the latest computers has been opened at our school.
fullContent:
A new information technology room equipped with the latest computers has been opened at our school.

The new room is equipped with 30 modern computers, an interactive whiteboard, a 3D printer, and VR devices. This allows students to gain in-depth knowledge in the IT field.

The project was implemented as part of the "Modern School" program.

title: Football Competition
content: The school championship among class teams has concluded. Winning teams were awarded commemorative gifts.
fullContent:
The school championship among class teams has concluded.

Teams made up of 11th-grade students participated in the competition. After intense matches, the 11th-"A" class team emerged victorious.

Winners and prize-winners were awarded diplomas and commemorative gifts.

title: Native Language Holiday
content: At the creative evening held on the theme "Language is the Wealth of the Nation," students showcased their talents.
fullContent:
At the creative evening held on the theme "Language is the Wealth of the Nation," students showcased their talents.

During the evening, students read poems, performed stage scenes, and gave speeches about the beauty of their native language.

The event was received with great interest by students and parents.

title: Open Lessons Week
content: We invite everyone interested to master classes conducted by experienced teachers.
fullContent:
We invite everyone interested to master classes conducted by experienced teachers.

During Open Lessons Week, each subject teacher demonstrates their best teaching methods. Modern pedagogical technologies are used in the lessons.

Parents and teachers from other schools are welcome to attend the lessons.

title: "Student of the Year" Competition Results
content: The final stage of determining the most active and knowledgeable student of the year was held at our school.
fullContent:
The final stage of determining the most active and knowledgeable student of the year was held at our school.

During the competition, students demonstrated their intellectual potential, creative abilities, and engagement in community work.

Winners were awarded diplomas and valuable commemorative gifts.

title: Spring Break Schedule Announced
content: Attention students and parents: the spring break days and club schedule have been approved.
fullContent:
Attention students and parents: the spring break days and club schedule have been approved.

The break lasts from March 21 to March 28. Sports and cultural events will be organized for students during the break.

Classes will begin on March 29 as usual.

title: School Football Championship
content: The football tournament among class teams has concluded.
fullContent:
The football tournament among class teams has concluded.

11 class teams participated in the tournament. After intense matches, the 11th-"A" class team emerged victorious.

Winners and prize-winners were awarded diplomas and commemorative gifts.

title: New Book Collection
content: Our library has been enriched with new literature for students.
fullContent:
Our library has been enriched with new literature for students.

Over 500 new books, including fiction, scientific, and educational materials, have been added to the library collection.

You can browse the new books on a special shelf in the library.

title: Subject Olympiads Have Begun
content: The winners of the school stage have advanced to the district stage.
fullContent:
The school stage of subject Olympiads has started.

Olympiads are being held in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, history, and native language.

Winners will earn the right to participate in the district stage.

title: Open Lessons Week
content: Experienced teachers are sharing their skills with the youth.
fullContent:

Modern pedagogical technologies are used in the lessons.

title: Chess Tournament
content: An exciting chess competition was held among our school's students.
fullContent:
An exciting chess competition was held among our school's students.

More than 30 students participated in the tournament. The games were conducted using the Swiss system.

Special gifts were awarded to the winners.

title: International Cooperation Memorandum
content: Our school has joined international projects to improve the quality of education.
fullContent:
Our school has joined international projects to improve the quality of education.

A memorandum of cooperation was signed with foreign educational institutions.

This partnership will create new opportunities for our students.

content: A parent-teacher meeting will be held regarding the upcoming quarter results.
fullContent:
A parent-teacher meeting will be held regarding the upcoming quarter results.

The meeting will discuss student academic performance indicators and plans for the new quarter.

All parents are invited.

title: Reading Competition Winners
content: Our students who read the most books were recognized by the school administration.
fullContent:
Our students who read the most books were recognized by the school administration.

The reading competition took place over 3 months. The most active students were rewarded with special diplomas and gifts.

The school library published a list of students who read the most books.

title: Basketball Competition

fullContent:
An inter-class basketball tournament will start in the coming days.

Senior students will participate in the tournament. The competition will be held using the Olympic system.

content: A modern STEM laboratory has begun its operation at our school.
fullContent:
A modern STEM laboratory has begun its operation at our school.

The laboratory is equipped with modern equipment in the fields of robotics, 3D modeling, and programming.

Students can use the laboratory free of charge.

title: Defenders of the Motherland Day
content: A festive event was held in honor of January 14 – Defenders of the Motherland Day.
fullContent:
A festive event was held in honor of January 14 – Defenders of the Motherland Day.

At the event, students read poems and performed military-patriotic songs.

A meeting with veterans was organized.

title: Zakovat Games
content: Another inter-class round was held as part of the Zakovat intellectual game.
fullContent:
Another inter-class round was held as part of the Zakovat intellectual game.

5 students from each class participated. Questions were based on the school curriculum and general knowledge.

The game was intense and engaging.

title: Athletics Winners
content: Our students stepped onto the podium at the regional stage.
fullContent:
Our students stepped onto the podium at the regional stage.

Our students won 3 gold, 2 silver, and 1 bronze medal at the regional athletics competition.

The school administration congratulated the winners.

title: School Library Modernization
content: A new system to expand the e-book database has been launched.
fullContent:
A new system to expand the e-book database has been launched.

Over 1,000 e-books are available in the library, and students can read them through a special platform.

The modern library system will make the learning process even more effective.

title: New Successes in the New Year
content: The head of our school congratulated students on the new academic year.
fullContent:
The head of our school congratulated students on the new academic year.

In the new year, students were wished success in striving towards great goals and acquiring knowledge.

The most active students were recognized at the ceremonial event.

fullContent:
